notes.title: DUMMS! - Version 0.4.0 released.
notes.content:
The new version of DUMMS! is out now!

This version focuses on fixing some small issues that were reported by some users and some small QOL changes.

Here is a list of the errors fixed in this version:

- Console still opens but it should not print any messages.
- Fixed the "Next Quest" text in the quests menu.
- Music loops correctly now. (before it just stopped playing after some time).
- Fixed options menu. Sometimes options did not work when clicking on them.
- Fixed an error with the quests gold. Low level quests were giving more gold than higher level ones.

And the QOL changes:

- Finished the basic tutorial. Explains skills, quests, upgrades and how to beat the game.
- Upped the max amount of dummies. Now there can be a maximum of 6 dummies, making it easier to hit something everytime.


I also want to address some of the changes I have planned for the next update, which will be released next week.

- Add a proper description for the "Upgrades" menu.
- Fix a bug where autospawn is not fast enough.
- Add a proper game end screen.
- Add steam achievements.

As mentioned above, these will be added in the "0.5.0" version.
